vectors.scenario: first valid source capture is durably persisted
higher generation with same cursor kind and non-regressing time
higher generation carries older observation time
source cursor kind changes for same source identity
concurrent writer advances prior generation/revision first

required_invariants: WORKS canonical SQLite Store owns durable source generation state
state is keyed by source class plus source ID
same-generation retries are accepted only when the capture is exactly identical
same-generation disagreement is equivocation and fails closed
observation time never regresses across advancing generations
cursor kind cannot silently change for an existing source identity
state revision strictly increases only on advancement
state digest is recomputed and verified on read
CAS-style update prevents lost concurrent advancement
verification grants no execution or promotion authority
